dedupe_keys.name: e4st jl electricity engineering and economic model

description: E4ST.jl is a Julia rewrite of the Engineering, Economic, and Environmental Electricity Simulation Tool. Its Cornell and Resources for the Future contributors publish an electricity-grid representation and optimisation model for generation, consumption, investment and retirement decisions. Inputs include network assets, generators, demand, technology costs and policy settings. The optimiser represents system operators and market participants, returning dispatch, investment, retirements, costs and emission-related outcomes for the chosen case. Geography and planning years follow the user-supplied network and scenario. GPL-3.0 source is public. A limitation is that the objective's cost and consumer-surplus terms are economic assumptions and cannot establish observed behaviour without calibration. E4ST supports transmission, generation and environmental-policy studies. The catalogue's model-pandapower is a separate network-analysis package; neither its data nor its results are automatically interchangeable with E4ST. No grid case was downloaded or solved.
name: E4ST.jl electricity engineering and economic model
